name: Mrs. Mayfield's Tales
source:
Memories are treasures. 
Slices of our life, of our past, preserved in our minds until they fade away.
In this visual novel you play the role of an old lady, Mrs. Mayfield, whose memory is not what it used to be. Be sure to tell a lot of stories to your nurse, Grace, while you can!

Can you find the right path to keep Mrs. Mayfield's mind as sharp as possible? Or will you let her precious memories slip away?

[From [url=https://c-games-dev.itch.io/mrs-mayfields-tales] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
回忆是宝藏。
我们生活的片段，我们过去的片段，保存在我们的脑海中，直到它们消失。
在这部视觉小说中，你扮演一位老太太，梅菲尔德夫人，她的记忆力已经不如以前了。趁还可以的时候，一定要给你的护士Grace讲很多故事！

你能找到正确的方法让梅菲尔德夫人的头脑尽可能保持敏锐吗？或者你会让她珍贵的记忆溜走吗？

[来自[url=https://c-games-dev.itch.io/mrs-mayfields-tales] itch.io[/url]]
